I have a network with a Roku 3, a Win 7 PC, and Win 8 PC. I have joined each PC to the network and the Roku3 sees the PC. But the Roku doesn't see any files on the PCs. Where in the heck to I put the files on the PCs so the Roku3 sees them? I've tried several directories with no luck.

My user on each PC has admin rights.

Thank you.
How to get Roku 3 to see files on other PCs on network?

You need to first allow devices to play from your PC.

Start > Media streaming options > [ Allow All ]

Once that is setup you should see the files on the Roku. It should show files from your Libraries: Music, Pictures, and Videos

If you want a much better viewing experience without having to worry about what formats the Roku will play, install the Plex Media Server on at least one PC and the Plex (or Rarflix) app on your Roku. You may need to create a free account with Plex, but you don't have to pay anything to use it (paid accounts get premium features).
